name: Project Image

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: a statuette of yourself worth 5+ GP

targets.description: a place within range you have seen before

summary: An intangible copy of you appears at a place you've seen up to 500 miles away; you see and hear through it.
text: As a Magic action you move it up to 60 feet and make it talk and act; it vanishes if it takes any damage. A Study action and an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC reveals it as an illusion.
